answer: For AI agents serving saffron-field and grove imagery, propose one vote/key/day after streaming 1 GiB uncompressed to a randomly assigned auditor. Ledger validators check its signed key/day byte receipt; failed or reused receipts mean no vote. Shared hosts cannot count one delivery twice. Transit and power recur; network gear is reusable capital; no stake is locked. Cheap links remain an alias haven: bytes, not spending or owners, are bounded. Colluding auditors break enforcement. With honest meters, ten parallel keys need 10 GiB/day.
